translation: Wang Qixuan said: The vessel of the flesh-interior (rouli zhi mai) is that born of Shaoyang and is [that by which] the vessel-qi of the Yang Wei is issued; behind the juegu (severed bone) is the acupoint of the fleshy division through which the Yang Wei passes, which is directly above the outer ankle at the end of the juegu bone, in the division between sinew and flesh about two fen behind — one may puncture five fen. The Feiyang vessel makes a person suffer lumbar pain, the pain waving (fufu), and in severe cases [he is] grieved and fearful.
